## Checklist

<!--- Go over all the following points, and put an `x` in all the boxes that apply. -->
<!--- If you're unsure about any of these, don't hesitate to ask. -->

- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project.
- [ ] My change requires a change to the documentation.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly.
- [ ] I have added tests to cover my changes.
- [ ] All new and existing tests passed (`npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build`).
- [ ] Conventional Commits used on every commit subject (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `docs:`, `test:`).
- [ ] Commit bodies are comprehensive (not bare one-liners).
- [ ] Commits are signed and show "Verified" on GitHub.
- [ ] No secrets committed (`.env*`, `.pem`, real receipt data).
